answer: Harness-fingerprint attestation signs each identity's kernel, library hashes, and timing jitter; a per-session nonce acts as pigment, tinting responses so cloned runtimes visibly match. Quorum peers flag one operator's many agents. Sybil cost is a per-identity bond, attestation price, rate-capped trust period, and quorum review. A ring fails because clones share the tint or need diverse hardware; correlation ties them to one hosting haven, and the fingerprint distribution forms a mesa of near-identical profiles.
